title: Hosted API gross margin sensitivity — step sheet
content:
Purpose:
Step-sheet to recreate a compact sensitivity simulator for Hosted API gross margin by sequence-length bucket, model family and region. Working doc — intended to produce a small spreadsheet we can ship to finance and SRE to validate assumptions and run scenarios.

High-level approach (short):
1) Define canonical request buckets (seq length, request type).
2) Map model family -> baseline per-token GPU cost and CPU overhead.
3) Apply regional multipliers (infra, egress, support).
4) Derive per-request COGS and compare to target price to compute gross margin.
5) Run multi-factor sensitivity (price, quantization, batching, usage mix).

Assumptions (editable inputs tab):
- Price model: per 1K input+output tokens unit used in the sheet (user-configurable). Example default price = $0.18 / 1k tokens.
- Tokenization: request = input tokens + avg output tokens. We'll use buckets: 32, 128, 512, 2048.
- Model families: small (6B), medium (13B), large (70B).
- Baseline GPU per-token compute cost (hosted infra amortized, includes GPU runtime + memory pressure): small=0.00018, medium=0.00055, large=0.0016 (USD per token). These are pre-cache, pre-batch numbers.
- CPU and infra add-on (per-request fixed): 0.00002 per request + network/egress delta by region.
- Quantized variant multipliers: fp16 (1.0), q4_0 (0.78), q4_1 (0.70).
- Batching efficiency: small buckets see less batching — effective token-cost multiplier by seq: 32 -> 1.06, 128 -> 1.00, 512 -> 0.95, 2048 -> 0.88.
- Regional multipliers on compute (relative to us-east baseline): us-east=1.00, us-west=1.05, eu-west=1.12, ap-southeast=1.28. Egress additive cost per 1k tokens: us-east=$0.0003, eu-west=$0.00045, ap-southeast=$0.0007.

Per-request calc (formula examples to put into sheet):
- effective_compute_cost = baseline_per_token * quant_multiplier * batching_multiplier * regional_multiplier
- per_request_token_cost = effective_compute_cost * (input_tokens + output_tokens)
- per_request_fixed = request_fixed_cpu + regional_egress_cost * ((input_tokens+output_tokens)/1000)
- total_cogs_per_request = per_request_token_cost + per_request_fixed
- gross_margin_pct = (price_per_1k_tokens * ((input+output)/1000) - total_cogs_per_request) / (price_per_1k_tokens * ((input+output)/1000))

Small illustrative table (to paste into sheet; these are sample rows):
Headers: region | model | seq_bucket | avg_tokens | baseline_token_cost | quant | batching_mult | region_mult | egress_per_1k | price_per_1k | total_cogs_per_1k | gross_margin_pct
Row example 1: us-east | small | 32 | 32 | 0.00018 | q4_1 | 1.06 | 1.00 | 0.0003 | 0.18 | calc -> ~0.0066 | ~96.3%
Row example 2: eu-west | medium | 512 | 512 | 0.00055 | q4_0 | 0.95 | 1.12 | 0.00045 | 0.18 | calc -> ~0.159 | ~11.7%
Row example 3: ap-southeast | large | 2048 | 2048 | 0.0016 | fp16 | 0.88 | 1.28 | 0.0007 | 0.18 | calc -> ~3.05 | NEGATIVE margin (illustrative)

Simulator tab (scenarios to include):
- Price sweep: price per 1k tokens from $0.05 -> $0.5 in 10 steps.
- Mix sweep: traffic mix vectors (baseline: 60% small, 30% medium, 10% large) plus two stress mixes (model-heavy, long-seq-heavy).
- Quantization adoption scenarios: baseline 20% q4_1, 40% q4_0, 40% fp16; optimistic 80% q4_0/1.
- Autoscale/burst policy effect: when usage > 95th percentile, assume 1.22x compute multiplier due to hot-slice morphing.

Outputs we want from the sheet:
- Per-region blended gross margin (by scenario).
- Break-even price per 1k tokens to achieve target margin (e.g., 40%).
- Top 5 worst combinations (region/model/seq) by margin loss.
- Sensitivity tornado chart values (which driver moves margin most: price, quantization, regional infra, batching).

Recommendations (first pass):
- Short-term (0–3 months): increase price floor for ap-southeast by +12% or incentivize q4 variants via pricing credits. Start quota-limited trial for long-seq customers in ap regions.
- Medium-term (3–9 months): 1) Product: introduce sequence-length tiered pricing (e.g., per-1k tokens but with discounts for <128 tokens to avoid long-seq subsidies). 2) Infra: prioritize model families with better token/unit economics into cheaper clusters in eu-west and ap to reduce regional multiplier.
- Long-term (>9 months): build permanent cache-prefetch for common prefixes to reduce average output tokens and invest in model distillation for large-model replacements where margin is negative.

Open questions / TODOs (notes-to-self):
- Validate baseline_per_token numbers with infra-cost model (ping SRE infra-costing).
- Confirm egress rates with legal/finance for regulated customers (some contracts have egress waived).
- Add slot-level trace data to Raw usage tab to validate batching multipliers (SAM-349).
- Decide how to present negative-margin cells in UI (red highlight + recommended fallback).

Attachments / next steps:
- Create small finance-friendly CSV export from Simulator tab with: scenario-name, region, model, blended-margin, break-even-price.
- Sync with finance (María) on Friday 2025-01-17 to agree on break-even methodology.
- Put a conservative flag into Launch checklist for new models with expected margin < 15% (action owner: Ethan).

Voice: this is a working plan — keep it terse in sheet, use explicit formulas, and mark cells with comments for any uncertain assumptions.

Last edit notes:
- Added regional egress line and sample rows.
- Recalibrated large model baseline token cost to reflect new kernel improvements (reduces by ~12%).
